title: Hold an air operator's certificate (AOC)
what: Aircraft may fly into, out of or within Australian territory in commercial operations only as authorised by an AOC from CASA (or a New Zealand AOC with ANZA privileges, or a CASA permission).

sources.title: Civil Aviation Act 1988
sources.quote: (2) Except as authorised by an AOC, by a New Zealand AOC with ANZA privileges that is in force for Australia (but only so far as it authorises ANZA activities in Australian territory), or by a permission under section 27A: (a) an aircraft shall not fly into or out of Australian territory; and (b) an aircraft shall not operate in Australian territory;

reach.condition: if it operates aircraft (commercial operations need an AOC)

assessment.summary: An AOC, with approved personnel, aircraft, manuals and safety systems, before commercial air operations.

marks.reason: An AOC, after CASA assessment of the operator, is needed before commercial flying.
Safety management systems, surveillance and record-keeping.
